messages:
Asha Nair: Kickoff: Saffron Health wants a short POC to replace EchoAI with Redwood. Primary asks: exact streaming frame compatibility, identical token billing behavior, HIPAA-ish controls, EU data residency, and a signed DPA. Goal: 3-week trial. Who can take tech lead?
Ben Wallace: I can run the tech POC. Need their top 1k prompts and a sample of their streaming frames (names + payload shapes).
Carmen Li: Sales asks: migration credit + pricing delta. Client requests cost parity for first 60 days. Proposing 35% credit, then review.
Tomás Alvarez: I'll spin up a Dedicated eu-central slice and pin model rdx-2.2-medium. Expect to tune batching to match Echo latency.
SecBot: Security: SOC2 present. KMS: AWS KMS or customer HSM supported on Private. DPA and EU residency supported with Private control plane. Need completed security questionnaire and DPO contact.
Asha Nair: Important blocker: their client expects three SSE event types: "part", "meta", "finish" and treats meta frames as important. We must preserve exact names and ordering.
Ben Wallace: I'll implement an Echo-compatible shim that proxies requests, preserves headers (X-Org, X-Client-Id), and emits the same SSE events. Example test curl: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://poc.redwood.local/echo/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>","stream":true}'```
Ben Wallace: SSE shim sketch: ```js
// emit same event types
res.write('data: ' + JSON.stringify({part: token_fragment}) + "\n\n");
res.write('event: meta\n' + 'data: ' + JSON.stringify(meta_obj) + "\n\n");
res.write('event: finish\n' + 'data: {}' + "\n\n");
```
Carmen Li: Evaluation criteria from the buyer: token-cost delta, latency P95, clinical intent F1, and regression rate on a 500-labeled clinical prompt set.
Tomás Alvarez: I'll coordinate with Ben on smoke infra. Ops-bot: provision request queued.
ops-bot: Dedicated slice eu-central provisioning started (ticket #45812). ETA 36h.
Ben Wallace: Action items for me: 1) build shim + header mapping, 2) implement SSE emitter with exact frame labels, 3) mirror Echo rate limits in shim (their default is 50/min), 4) run smoke tests with Tomás.
SecBot: Note: audit log retention of 18 months possible on Private. DPA addendum required for EU residency.
Asha Nair: Timeline: Week0 infra + shim; Week1 streaming parity smoke; Week2 evaluation runs; Week3 wrap and contracting.
Carmen Li: I'll draft pricing + migration credit text and post for review by EOD tomorrow.
Tomás Alvarez: I'll have infra up by Friday for initial smoke.
Asha Nair: Can everyone confirm? I'll schedule a POc kickoff with Saffron for Monday 10:00 CET.
Ben Wallace: Confirmed. I'll get sample frames from their eng contact and start the shim.
Carmen Li: Confirmed. Posting pricing draft once ready. :thumbsup:
SecBot: Reminder: upload completed security questionnaire and DPO contact to thread.
Asha Nair: Thanks team 1 marking this thread as the POC canonical thread. I'll post artifacts as they arrive.
